title: Constructibility of etale sum-extension with Noetherian coefficients
statement: Let $X$ and $U$ be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $j:U\to X$ an etale morphism, $R$ a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and $M$ a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. On their small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], write $R_X,R_U$ and $\underline M_U$ for the constant ring and module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. A sheaf of $R_X$-modules is called constructible if it admits a finite partition by locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification] on which its inverse-image restrictions are locally constant with finitely generated $R$-module values [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules, def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then $j_!\underline M_U$ is constructible, where $j_!$ is the sheafified etale sum-extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. The underlying sets of $R$ and $M$ may be infinite.

source.place: Tag 03S8, lemma-jshriek-constructible (3), etale-cohomology.tex lines 12185-12212; finite module means finitely generated over the Noetherian coefficient ring.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-stratified-finite] to the given etale morphism $j:U\to X$. Its hypotheses are precisely that both $U$ and $X$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Obtain a finite stratification $i_a:X_a\to X$ by constructible locally closed subschemes for which $U_a=U\times_XX_a$ and $\pi_a:U_a\to X_a$ are finite etale. Write $v_a:U_a\to U$ for the other projection.

source.place: Tag 03S8, lemma-jshriek-constructible, first sentence of the proof; Tag 03S0.

proof.text: For every $a$, apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-base-change-modules] with $f=i_a$, the given $j$ and the input sheaf $\underline M_U$. The coefficient ring in that statement is an arbitrary commutative ring, so $R$ is allowed. Its inverse comparison gives $i_a^{-1}j_!\underline M_U\cong\pi_{a!}v_a^{-1}\underline M_U$. By [lemma-constructible-pullback-constant], $v_a^{-1}\underline M_U\cong\underline M_{U_a}$, with the same $R$-module $M$. Thus $i_a^{-1}j_!\underline M_U\cong\pi_{a!}\underline M_{U_a}$.

source.place: Tag 03S8, displayed restriction identity, using Tag 03S6, lemma-shriek-base-change.

proof.text: Each $\pi_a$ is finite etale, so apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-star-finite-modules] to the $R_{U_a}$-module sheaf $\underline M_{U_a}$. Its canonical isomorphism $\pi_{a!}\underline M_{U_a}\cong\pi_{a*}\underline M_{U_a}$ yields $i_a^{-1}j_!\underline M_U\cong\pi_{a*}\underline M_{U_a}$. Finiteness of the coefficient ring is not a hypothesis of the cited statement.

source.place: Tag 03S8, displayed restriction identity, using Tag 03S7, lemma-shriek-equals-star-finite-etale.

proof.text: The constant module sheaf $\underline M_{U_a}$ is locally constant of finite type: in [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules], use the identity covering and the given finitely generated module $M$ on every localized object. Apply [lem-per-finite-etale-pushforward-finite-type] with $f=\pi_a$. It gives that $\pi_{a*}\underline M_{U_a}$ is etale locally isomorphic, as an $R_{X_a}$-module sheaf, to constant finitely generated $R$-modules. Through the isomorphism of step 3 the same local trivializations trivialize $i_a^{-1}j_!\underline M_U$.

source.place: Tag 03S8, last two sentences of the proof, and Tag 095B, lemma-pushforward-locally-constant.

proof.text: The finitely many immersed locally closed strata of step 1 are pairwise disjoint and cover $X$, as in [def-constructible-stratification]. Step 4 gives the required locally constant finitely generated module restrictions on every one. This is exactly the constructibility criterion stated in the item. It also covers the empty stratification when $X$ is empty and the zero module on strata with empty inverse image. No step assumed that $R$ or $M$ has a finite underlying set.

source.place: Tag 03S8, conclusion of the proof and the definition of constructibility.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03S8, lemma-jshriek-constructible (3), entire proof, using Tags 03S0, 03S6, 03S7 and 095B.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q99-707657bbe (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, the new node and every cited statement in full. Sources: Stacks 03S8 lemma-jshriek-constructible (3) (l.12185-12212) and 095B lemma-pushforward-locally-constant (l.9973-9990). No SGA source is used. The item statement is unchanged from Q23's version, matches 03S8(3) hypothesis by hypothesis, and matches the constructibility notion the parent uses with M=R. Step 1: 03S0 stratification, qcqs X and U checked. Step 2: 03S6 module base change (any commutative Lambda) with f=i_a, plus constant pullback (its category of values includes Lambda-modules), giving i_a^{-1}j_!M = pi_{a!}M. Step 3: 03S7 shriek=star for finite etale pi, any ring. Step 4: a constant sheaf is locally constant of finite type (maximal sieve); apply the new node and move the trivializations across the isomorphism. Step 5: elementary assembly, including empty X and empty strata. New node lem-per-finite-etale-pushforward-finite-type is true: etale-locally the finite etale map splits into n sheets, and a common refinement gives a finite product of finitely generated modules (zero when n=0). No finiteness of R or M is needed (checked with R=Z, M=Z). B1-B9 hold. It strictly generalizes lem-weil-pbc-etale-finite-pushforward-locally-constant, which needs a finite Lambda and so does not apply here; it is not a duplicate or a restatement. lem-weil-pbc-etale-free-sheaf-constructible is the finite-Lambda case of the item, so the item is not a duplicate either. The six generic sk-thm-p1 tool_uses are accepted. No cycle. No changes.

lean.statement: theorem exists_noetherian_etale_sum_constructible {X U : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace U] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U] (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) [Module.Finite R M] : ∃ S : FiniteLocallyClosedStratification X, ∀ i : Fin S.n, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) (S.immersion i)).obj ((Etale.etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) j inferInstance).obj ((constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)).obj M)))

reviewed_lean.note: Statement matches node and Stacks 03S8(3) clause by clause: qcqs X,U; Etale j; R : Type (u+1) CommRing + IsNoetherianRing (recorded u+1 coefficient convention, as in upstream 03SA siblings and the Q59-accepted dep record); M : ModuleCat R with Module.Finite only (infinite R, M allowed); recorded etaleLowerShriek of constantSheaf; ∃ FiniteLocallyClosedStratification (no constructible-strata strengthening, per the node's own definition) ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf of upperStar along S.immersion i (cover-constant + f.g. stalks = node's locally-≅-f.g.-constant, the exposed interface of def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules). Edge cases (empty X: n=0; empty U; M=0) covered. No duplicate: upstream _of_isNoetherian/_of_isAffine/_SpecMap/_of_stratification and K1 finite-Λ core differ. Only sorry; docstrings with source/blueprint and 5 proof steps; plain imports = the three Lean-recorded proof_dep modules; statement verbatim; node otherwise identical to live. nt_compile --json clean (2.2 s).
